title: Erdős problem 931: prime-support interval
statement: Let k1≥k2≥3 and n1+k1≤n2. If the products of n1+1,…,n1+k1 and n2+1,…,n2+k2 have the same sets of prime divisors, then the inclusive interval [n1,n2] contains a prime.

counterexample.description: Natural numbers k1,k2,n1,n2 satisfying the hypotheses, with equal prime supports for the two consecutive-integer products but no prime in the inclusive interval [n1,n2].
